extDescription.message: One day a week, blocks ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and friends. See if you've still got it.

blockedFooter.message: Everything is back to normal tomorrow.

message1.message: Today you do the thinking. Help is back tomorrow.

message2.message: Your head has tokens too, and today they are free.

message3.message: Remember how a git rebase works? Today you will find out.

message4.message: Stack Overflow still exists. Go say hi.

message5.message: Offer valid until midnight. Cannot be combined with other assistants.

message6.message: Ask your mother. She has been waiting for you to call.

message7.message: You know how to do this. Just try it.

message8.message: Ask the coworker at the next desk. They like being asked.

message9.message: Google still works. So do friends with opinions.

message10.message: Write the message yourself. Whoever reads it will know it is yours.

message11.message: Blank page? Start with a bad sentence and fix it later.

message12.message: Today the mistakes are yours. You learn from those too.

message13.message: Go for a walk. The answer may turn up on the way.
